name: Scones
notes: Add-in ideas: 1+ tsp orange zest and dried cranberries; 1+ tsp lemon zest and dried blueberry; ½ tsp almond to sour cream mixture and dried cherries.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Stir together: **2 cups flour**, **⅓ cup sugar**, **1 tsp baking powder**, **¼ tsp baking soda** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Grate in the butter
steps.body: Grate in **8 Tbsp butter**, frozen. Work in with fingers to resemble coarse meal.

steps.title: Whisk the wet ingredients
steps.body: Whisk together **½ cup sour cream** and **1 egg**.

steps.title: Form the dough
steps.body: Stir egg/sour cream into flour mixture with fork then press dough into a ball against edge of the bowl with hand.

steps.title: Shape the dough
steps.body: Place on a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7–8-inch circle, ¾-inch thick. Sprinkle with **1 tsp sugar**, and cut into 8 triangles.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place on a parchment-lined pan sheet. Bake at 350°F until golden, 15–17 minutes.
